children: Turkey's Tera Portfoy said in a stock exchange filing on Wednesday that it defaulted on redemption payments for its Tera Portfoy Money Market Lira Fund.
The company said reconciliations with brokerage firms through which transactions were conducted and liquidity management efforts for the fund were ongoing.
